visualCharacteristics: A horizontal rule separating content. Default is a full-width 1px light-grey (#ebebeb) hairline; an accent variant renders a short WKND-yellow 2px rule; a spacing variant is invisible (whitespace only).
contentPattern: Empty block — no authored cells. The block presence renders the rule.
usage: Visual separator between page regions (e.g. between a content list and a follow-up block). Use instead of a bare <hr>, which EDS treats as a section boundary rather than a visible line.
